title: 1RB1LD_0RC0RF_1LC0LA_0LE1LD_1LA---_0RB0LF: the event map proved in Lean, and one way to halt
text: The event map of 1RB1LD_0RC0RF_1LC0LA_0LE1LD_1LA---_0RB0LF is now a Lean theorem: wherever the map answers, the machine goes from the left end with one list of blocks to the left end with the next (visit_sound), from the list 7, 2 at step 66. Lean also proves that the machine halts when the dealing meets a block of value 5, as from the lists that begin 4, 3 or 7, 1. The run of the map is at 6.9·10^10 events without a halt and still going; near misses keep the same rate per doubling.
